description: Zuckerberg's 2019 pledge to refocus Meta on private, ephemeral, and small-group sharing over the public feed.
Meta and Instagram leadership have repeatedly stated sharing is moving from the public feed into Stories, Close Friends, and direct messages.

signal: Instagram is no longer a square photo-sharing app
description: Head of Instagram Adam Mosseri stated Instagram is shifting from photos toward video and messaging, away from the curated grid.
Widely reported pressure to post only polished content suppresses authentic in-progress sharing on the main feed.

signal: Quantitative split of sharing by surface
description: Exact share of activity in Stories vs Feed vs Reels vs DMs is NOT publicly disclosed by Meta.
